phil_charter_title: We reject Hegelian dialectics — we choose classical disputation for truth
phil_charter_intro: The Plowshare Pact rejects the Hegelian method (thesis → antithesis → synthesis), which dissolves objective truth into relativistic compromise. Our discussions, Rhetorical Shield, and epistolary polemics are governed by five classical methodologies grounded in Christian realism and natural law:
phil_m1_desc: In the spirit of St. Thomas Aquinas (Videtur quod → Sed contra → Respondeo), we first state the opponent’s argument in its fairest and strongest form, then answer it with unchanging moral principle and verifiable evidence.
phil_m2_desc: Respect for the interlocutor as a person paired with uncompromising defense of principle — without personal invective, strawmen, or relativism.
phil_m3_desc: Exposing false dichotomies (e.g. 'either Poland-Sparta or defenselessness') and demonstrating internal contradictions in the opponent’s premises (Distinguo).
phil_m4_desc: Christian political prudence (10,000 facing 20,000 → delegation of peace), set against the pagan maxim of Vegetius (Si vis pacem, para bellum) and the Sanacja recklessness of 1939.
phil_m5_desc: We break complex objections into distinct claims and answer each strictly from verbatim source quotes and approved argument cards.
phil_pillars_title: Five Pillars of the “Oasis of Peace of Central Europe” Doctrine
phil_p1: I. Sovereignty of Peace over Garrison Sovereignty (Swiss-Austrian model, not mechanical copy)
phil_p2: II. Fertility of the Plowshare over Sterility of the Sword (Eisenhower 1953, 1 Sam 8, Bastiat)
phil_p3: III. Christian Royal Reckoning (Luke 14:31–32) over pagan Vegetius
phil_p4: IV. Ending Risk Asymmetry (John 10:11–13 — The Good Shepherd vs. the Hireling & Kuty Bridge 1939)
phil_p5: V. Constitutional Armed Neutrality & The Hedgehog Doctrine (Hague V, Austria 1955, Malta Art. 1(3), asymmetric deterrence)

landing_hero_alt: A crown of thorns lit by a beam of light beside a jewelled royal crown lying among chains and coins on a stone altar
landing_lead: The people asked for a king “just like all the other nations.” God granted the request — and told them, item by item, what that crown would cost.
landing_cost_intro: Samuel did not argue in the abstract. He listed what a king would take: your children, your labour, your land, your harvest — and finally your freedom.
landing_c_labour: Your sons at his plough and his forge
landing_c_land: Your best land to his officials
landing_tally: Sons · Daughters · Fields · Vineyards · Orchards · Grain · Flocks · Freedom
landing_close_title: One crown serves. The other takes.
landing_close_body: The jewelled crown is paid for with other people’s sons, fields and harvests, and it ends in chains. The crown of thorns was worn by the King who gave instead of taking. Przymierze Lemiesza stands with the plough, not the throne.
shield_preset_hedgehog_text: Neutrality relies on the goodwill of neighbors, and caught between Russia and Germany that is naive and leaves us at the mercy of enemies — without a massive army they will crush us.
landing_hedgehog_title: The Hedgehog Doctrine over Debt-Ridden Sparta
landing_hedgehog_lead: Neutrality does not rely on a neighbor's mercy, but on cold game theory: invasion must be unprofitable. Asymmetric territorial defense (the Swiss model) ensures the cost of swallowing the hedgehog far exceeds any aggressor's gains.
landing_hedgehog_sparta_1: Arms race and usurious debt consuming up to 50% of the national budget
landing_hedgehog_sparta_2: Foreign licenses and equipment without source codes or domestic munitions
landing_hedgehog_sparta_3: Barracks suffocating demography and draining productive civilian capital
landing_hedgehog_sparta_4: Risk asymmetry: elites flee to Kuty bridge, ordinary citizens stay under bombs
landing_hedgehog_jeza_1: Asymmetric cost-benefit calculus grounded in cold game theory
landing_hedgehog_jeza_2: Widespread territorial defense, drones, territorial saturation, and civil defense
landing_hedgehog_jeza_3: Fertility of the Plowshare: industry, agriculture, and families multiplying national strength
landing_hedgehog_jeza_4: Inviolable trade and transit bridge: The Oasis of Peace of Central Europe
home_manifesto_title: The Anvil of Peace & Fertility of the Plowshare
home_manifesto_lead: The sword brings ruin, usurious debt, and death on foreign battlefields. The plowshare bears bread, nurtures families, and safeguards ancestral land. Przymierze Lemiesza turns towards what is enduring and life-giving.
home_manifesto_quote: “They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.”
home_pillars_title: Three Pillars for the Future of the Commonwealth
home_pillars_lead: Choose a perspective to explore our strategic doctrine, foundational analyses, and Christian realism:
power_hero_lead: Political realism in the vise of empires. Constructing sovereignty and domestic economic strength instead of romantic illusions, perpetual debt, and serving as an expendable buffer for naval powers.
power_deconstruction_lead: Propaganda persuades Poles that sovereignty equates to foreign alliance dependency. In Christian realism, surrendering the sovereign key to war and peace is a complete oxymoron:
power_oxymoron_1_title: 1. Military Oxymoron: Army on foreign tethers
power_oxymoron_1_body: Weapons acquired without source codes, bound to foreign kill-switches, and devoid of domestic ammunition supply chains. When crisis strikes, foreign command decides operational readiness.
power_oxymoron_2_body: Allocating 4–5% of GDP on foreign loans amid catastrophic demographic decline. Siphoning capital away from Polish families and enterprise directly into foreign treasuries.
power_oxymoron_3_title: 3. Legal Oxymoron: Surrendering Ius ad Bellum
power_oxymoron_3_body: Ceding the sovereign monopoly over the blood of our sons to distant ocean metropolises and automated treaty obligations.
power_oxymoron_4_title: 4. Geopolitical Oxymoron: Role of living buffer
power_oxymoron_4_body: In offshore-balancing doctrines, the 'eastern flank' is merely an operational cushion designed to absorb catastrophic initial devastation to spare the distant hegemon.
power_sanacja_title: Lesson of 1939: The Sanacja frenzy and Kuty bridge
power_sanacja_body: In 1939, the regime funnelled nearly half the budget into military parades while rural villages starved. When war arrived, paper guarantees evaporated, and the ruling elites fled across the bridge to Kuty, leaving the nation defenseless and unfortified.
power_real_title: Authentic Power: The Strength of Fertility & Capital
power_real_body: True national power is quantified by protected families, thriving agriculture, food and energy sovereignty, water retention, and manufacturing capability — not debt and foreign military bases.
hedgehog_7spikes_title: Seven Spikes of the Plowshare: Organic Defense Architecture
hedgehog_7spikes_lead: Instead of an invasive hornet drawing fire onto our own cities — achieving complete territorial indigestibility (the Swiss model):
hedgehog_spike_1_desc: River renaturalization, wetlands, and micro-retention. Multiplies crops and quenches drought in peace; paralyzes armor thrusts in conflict.
hedgehog_spike_2_desc: Fiber-optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing along roads and railways. Passive acoustic listening without radio emissions, entirely immune to EW jamming.
hedgehog_spike_3_desc: Multispectral passive netting, aerosol barriers, and infrastructure dispersal shielding populations from satellites and drones.
hedgehog_spike_4_desc: Municipal grain silos, agricultural biogas, and decentralized water wells resilient to centralized grid shutdown.
hedgehog_spike_5_desc: The Swiss standard: reinforced, ventilated shelters with supplies and medical provisions under every home and district.
hedgehog_spike_6_desc: Off-grid amateur radio mesh networks functioning independently of internet and commercial satellite links during blackouts.
hedgehog_spike_7_desc: Universal civil defense education, scouting, trauma medical skills, marksmanship, and deep neighborhood solidarity.
